interface_detail: REST API: an OpenAI-style chat completions endpoint at https://api.nineteen.ai/v1/chat/completions with a bearer API key, documented at nineteen.ai/app/api with curl, Python SDK and JavaScript SDK examples.

chaining: A free OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a drop-in for any agent loop that expects a base_url and a key, so it chains with local tooling without a gateway.
